build_caveat: The legacy src/Polly/Polly.csproj (the older, pre-Polly.Core API surface) does NOT build under our SDK: Context.Dictionary.cs uses the C# 13 'field' keyword (auto-property backing field access), which requires the .NET 10 SDK/compiler. This project was excluded from the corpus; Polly.Core (the actively developed, modern API) and its satellite packages (Polly.Extensions, Polly.RateLimiting, Polly.Testing) all build cleanly and were probed/verified.
restore_modifications: The without-tests cell's project discovery is path-based over the whole checkout (arms/_lib/armkit.py's is_test_path), not corpus.json's product_projects — so it always finds all 6 non-test .csproj under src/ (Polly.Core, Polly.Extensions, Polly.RateLimiting, Polly.Testing, the legacy Polly, and Snippets), regardless of which of those are graded. src/Snippets/Snippets.csproj is a code-samples project (xunit-referencing but not under test/, so classified as product) hardcoded to <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>, which the pinned SDK 8.0.421 cannot even restore (NETSDK1045 — this is a restore-time TFM check, not a build-time one). Left unrestored, the engine's own coverage guard correctly refuses the whole without-tests cell: 'Refusing to analyze: at least one project has no restore output'. Fixed 2026-08-24 by retargeting Snippets.csproj to net8.0 (matching the TFM every other src/ project already builds for) — see corpus-patches/Polly.patch. This makes 'dotnet restore' succeed for all 6 discovered projects so the guard is satisfied honestly rather than relaxed. Snippets is still NOT in product_assemblies/product_projects and is NOT one of the oracle_assemblies below — nothing about it is graded; its .dll is never fed to the oracle. It is restored (and consequently analyzed by our arm, since the arm runs per-discovered-project) solely so the guard can pass on genuinely complete restore state; any edges the arm emits with a caller in src/Snippets/ were checked against the grader's cell_of() classification after the 2026-08-24 rerun and must land outside the primary comparable cell (see results notes for that run) or the corpus fix would silently contaminate the measured cell.

name: FluentValidation/FluentValidation
build_modifications: global.json sdk.version changed from 10.0.0 (unavailable) to 8.0.100 (rollForward=latestFeature already present). Two MSBuild property overrides were required at build time, NOT source edits: (1) -p:DebugType=portable — Directory.Build.props sets <DebugType>embedded</DebugType>, which embeds the PDB inside the DLL with no sibling .pdb file at all, so the oracle tool (which reads a separate .pdb) saw 100% no-debug-info until this was overridden; (2) -p:ContinuousIntegrationBuild=false — the csproj sets ContinuousIntegrationBuild=true for Release config, which triggers deterministic source-path remapping so the PDB's CallerFile values are prefixed '/_/' instead of being the real repo-relative path; overriding this makes CallerFile values resolve directly against the repo root.
build_caveat: About 5.3% of edges with a non-null CallerFile point into src/FluentValidation/obj/.../System.Text.RegularExpressions.Generator/RegexGenerator.g.cs — a Regex source-generator's virtual output file. The PDB records this path but the generator does not persist it to disk (EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles is off), so those specific rows will not resolve to a real file even though NoDebugInfo=false for them. This is a legitimate generated-code category, not a broken build; spot-checks were done on genuine first-party rows instead.
test_detection_rule: naming suffix .Tests / .Tests.Benchmarks; FluentValidation.Tests.csproj references Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk + xunit; all product and test projects live side by side under src/, distinguished by name only (no separate test/ directory)
test_assemblies_note: Built assemblies, not project files. The pin originally listed .csproj paths here, which the runner could never treat as an answer-key input — the with-tests cell was refused for all three repositories until this was corrected on 2026-08-24.
with_tests_cell: unavailable: the test projects target net10.0 and do not build on the pinned SDK 8.0.421 (NETSDK1045). Recorded rather than silently skipped — the cell is missing, not zero.
